_comment: #2374 — typecheck for Playwright specs. tsconfig.json and tsconfig.test.json both exclude e2e/, and Playwright transpiles without typechecking, so a spec's typed mocks (`satisfies` against the BFF wire types) fail on shape drift only if this config runs; `npm run typecheck` runs it. Every spec is checked: #2605 fixed the last excluded ones and scripts/tsconfig-e2e.test.ts fails if a spec is excluded again.
